get.description:
Get analytics for a brand (running-ads distribution, creative velocity) as a series of analytics rows. A successful call returns **one row per day** (`date`, `active_count`, `inactive_count`, and per-format counts).

**Important:** the `id` parameter must be a page_id / `ad_library_id` (obtained from the `getBrandsByDomain` response), NOT a Foreplay `brand_id`. Passing a `brand_id` returns HTTP 406. Flow: `getBrandsByDomain(domain)` -> `ad_library_id` -> `brand/analytics(id=ad_library_id)`.

**Date window:** the window between `start_date` and `end_date` must be ≤ 30 days. A larger range returns HTTP 406 `Date range too large`.

**Cost estimation:** each returned row is 1 billed item . Because the response is one row per day, a 30-day window can bill up to ~30 items.

 empty results and 4xx/5xx errors are not charged.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.875 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 provider_credit $0 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

parameters.description: End date (inclusive). Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD', 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS', or 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'. If you provide only the date (e.g. '2024-11-12'), it will be interpreted as '2024-11-12 00:00:00'. To include all results for a given day, set end_date to 'YYYY-MM-DD 23:59:59' or to the next day at '00:00:00'. Examples: start_date=2024-11-12 00:00:00, end_date=2024-11-12 23:59:59. The window between start_date and end_date must be ≤ 30 days. A larger range returns HTTP 406 `Date range too large`.
parameters.name: end_date

parameters.description: Page ID or Brand ID. Brand IDs are 20-25 character alphanumeric strings with mixed case. Page IDs are numeric Facebook page identifiers.
parameters.name: id

parameters.description: Order of results: 'newest' (default), 'oldest', 'longest_running', or 'most_relevant'. Sorts ads by creation date, longest running duration, or relevance to the search query.
parameters.name: order

parameters.description: Start date (inclusive). Format: 'YYYY-MM-DD', 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS', or 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS'. If you provide only the date (e.g. '2024-11-12'), it will be interpreted as '2024-11-12 00:00:00'. To get all ads from a specific day, set end_date to 'YYYY-MM-DD 23:59:59' or to the next day at '00:00:00'. Examples: start_date=2024-11-12 00:00:00, end_date=2024-11-12 23:59:59. The window between start_date and end_date must be ≤ 30 days. A larger range returns HTTP 406 `Date range too large`.
parameters.name: start_date

200.description: JSON envelope with `metadata` and a `data[]` array of analytics rows (one row per day, each with `date`, `active_count`, `inactive_count`, and per-format counts). Each row in `data[]` counts as one billed item.

default.description: Error response; upstream passthrough responses may use provider formats

get.description:
Retrieve ads for one or more Foreplay brand IDs, applying the supplied filters. Each result in `data[]` is a full ad object.

**Accepts `brand_ids` only.** `page_id` lookup is NOT supported on the AIsa gateway — resolve a domain to its `ad_library_id` / brand id via `getBrandsByDomain` first. Passing a page id in `brand_ids` returns HTTP 200 with `count: 0` (silently treated as an unknown brand). This is intentional P0 scoping, documented as a known limitation.

 empty results and 4xx/5xx errors are not charged.

<!-- aisa-pricing:start -->
按用量计费；默认请求预估费用：$0.875 USD（不是固定价格）。 声明的单位费率：每 provider_credit $0 USD。 最终费用以账户适用价格及实际结算为准。
<!-- aisa-pricing:end -->

parameters.description: Brand ID(s) to search for. Can be a single ID or multiple IDs separated by commas.
parameters.name: brand_ids

parameters.description: Best-effort live fallback. If the cached results are empty and `collect=true`, the API translates each brand id to its Meta page id (`adlibraryid`), kicks off a live fetch through our Spyder pipeline, and polls for ~30 seconds. Returns whatever is available at the end of the window — may still be empty if a brand has no Meta page on file, the page is restricted, deleted, or simply isn't running ads. Not perfect — use it as a fallback when the regular response is empty, not as a default.
parameters.name: collect

 empty results and 4xx/5xx errors are not charged.

The system will automatically format and clean the domain. This endpoint looks up candidate brands based on the provided domain. The returned brands are potential matches and are not guaranteed to be definitively associated with the domain.
